description: Angular component for entity alias input with form control, filtering, and alias management.

classes.name: EntityAliasInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for entity alias input with filtering and alias management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form control, sets up value change subscriptions, and loads entity aliases from controller.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form control value programmatically.

methods.name: onEntityAliasFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if alias is dirty.

methods.name: clearEntityAlias
methods.description: Clears the alias input and refocuses the input element.

methods.name: fetchEntityAliases
methods.description: Filters entity aliases based on search text and returns as observable.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates the current form control value to external model.
